summary.description: One-paragraph verdict on the change as a whole. Becomes the PR review body.

coverage.description: Exactly: examined N of M changed files. The count is secondary to examined_paths set validation.

examined_paths.description: Every authoritative PR file path examined, echoed exactly from the prompt.

findings.description: Correctness defects only. Empty array is a valid, meaningful answer.

severity.description: P1 blocks merge, P2 should be resolved, P3 is advisory.

title.description: One line, imperative — what to change.

path.description: Repository-relative path, forward slashes. Must be a file this PR changes.

line.description: Line number in the post-change file, inside this PR's diff.

body.description: The evidence: what breaks, on what input, and why the change causes it.
